title.zh: 至少有 1 位重复的数字

desc.zh: 用不重复数字的互斥分组，推导前缀计数与停止条件。
desc.en: Count disjoint unique-digit blocks and derive the equal-prefix stopping rule.

complexity: O(D²) time; O(D) auxiliary space, D = decimal digit count (fixed base 10)

concepts.name: Unique-digit complement counting
concepts.description: Subtract disjoint unique-digit blocks from the positive integer range.

concepts.name: Equal-prefix counting invariant
concepts.description: Count smaller prefixes and stop the equal path at its first repeated digit.
